design_evaluation.summary: A polished dark/light dual-theme personal tech hub with strong hero hierarchy, a clear login modal, functional mobile menu, and a well-gated AI chat with consent flow. Main deductions come from overlapping floating widgets obscuring content, truncated text, and weak accessibility affordances (low-contrast links, no visible focus cues).
strengths: Clear hero hierarchy: large two-tone headline, supporting paragraph, stats bar, and two distinct CTAs (ui-home-desktop, ui-theme-toggle).
Theme toggle produces a coherent light theme with consistent palette mapping (purple/blue accent preserved on Live Feed, headings, and tab active state).
Login modal is well structured: active-tab underline, labeled Email/Password fields with placeholders, full-width Login CTA, and a 'Forgot password?' recovery link (ui-login-modal).
Mobile menu preserves all six nav items including the accent-colored 'Break it' action, with a visible close button and logo retained (ui-mobile-menu).
Chat panel uses a responsible consent gate: plain-language disclaimer, terms link, required checkbox, and disabled 'Agree & Start Chat' until acceptance (ui-chat-opens).
Nav consistency across desktop and mobile: identical item set and ordering, with 'Break it' rendered as a highlighted pill in both.
Status badges in the AI Test Result card (Passed/Warning) provide clear color-plus-text semantics.
issues: Floating 'Voice Agent' widget and chat launcher overlap and clip the fourth feature card's description ('unsupported AI claims...' is cut off) on the desktop home screen.
Terminal mockup text is truncated mid-command ('--workers=4' clipped at container edge), reading as an accidental crop rather than intentional overflow.
Light-theme 'Check' link (Reliability & Fact Check card) is yellow-on-light with low contrast; other card links (Explore/Scan/Verify) also rely on color alone to distinguish actions.
No visible focus indicators or hover state evidence in any screenshot; accessibility cues rely solely on color and iconography.
Stats module is inconsistent across captures (ARTICLES TODAY shows 4, 1, and 12) — if live-counting, the value needs layout stability so it doesn't shift the stats bar.
In the chat-open state, the hero right-side terminal is mostly hidden behind the panel, leaving a large ambiguous empty region at the top of the chat panel before the 'Before we start' block.

Mobile menu items have uneven vertical spacing and the hamburger/menu trigger is not visible in the open state (only a close X), which is acceptable but worth verifying the trigger remains discoverable.
'Break it' uses a warning-style red outline treatment as a regular nav destination, which may confuse destructive-action expectations.
